messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: smart-routing-fallback errors > 12% over 5m for prod. Alert rule: "downstream-fallback-error-rate". Samples show many 5xx from fallback path.

pagerduty-bot: Paging maya (oncall). Use /ack to accept.

maya (oncall): acked. looking. initial triage in #incidents.

sam (sre): visual: region-us-east fallback rate spike at 23:02 UTC, concurrent requests to region-us-west jumped ~2x. latency P95 rose from 120ms -> 900ms.

lee (infra): logs show many requests routed to model:xlarge-quant-v2 (fallback variant) that isn't warmed. cold starts + spinup -> queueing.

irene (eng-runtime): wait we rolled a routing policy change in the last deploy that prefers "compatible-variant" mapping for deprecated models. might be mapping to xlarge-quant-v2 by mistake.

maya (oncall): who owns the mapping? @irene?

irene (eng-runtime): yes, that rollout included a compatibility table tweak. rolling back now.

sam (sre): immediate customer impact: increased errors and tail latency; some customers reporting 5xx and timeouts. putting incident severity to S2. paging CS. @jane-cs can you summarise impacted tenants?

jane-cs: notified top 10 customers with high request rate. some experienced >30% failed requests. sending status email now.

maya (oncall): root cause hypothesis: client retries + smart-routing fallback misroute -> many clients retried to origin which triggered fallback to another region, and server-side failover + retry policy doubled traffic into us-west causing thundering herd. need to reduce retry amplification fast.

irene (eng-runtime): confirm: our server-side failover uses immediate requeue to next region without jitter. combined with clients retrying aggressively (exponential backoff disabled by some SDK versions) -> amplification.

sam (sre): mitigation plan: 1) disable cross-region fallback policy (quick toggle), 2) apply request-level circuit-breaker on model variant xlarge-quant-v2, 3) set ingress throttles for clients over threshold, 4) release advisory to SDK teams to enforce backoff header.

lee (infra): executing toggle: `POST /api/v1/routing/policies/disable?policy=region-fallback` -> returning 200. (reacted :white_check_mark: by lee)

irene (eng-runtime): deploying circuit-breaker rule:
```
circuit-breaker {
  target: "model:xlarge-quant-v2"
  max_inflight: 50
  backoff_jitter: true
}
```
applied to runtime, scaling down connections to that variant.

sam (sre): adding immediate header mitigation: set response header `Retry-After: 1` on failovers and `X-Allow-Client-Retry: false` for affected routes so SDK can honor. pushing via config: `envoy-route-mod` patch.

maya (oncall): can we also gate matchmaking so we don't cold-start huge variants?

irene (eng-runtime): yes toggled variant-warmup-required = true for xlarge-quant-v2. will prevent new matches until warmed.

lee (infra): metrics: traffic to us-west dropped from 2x -> 1.05x over 60s. error-rate trending down to 3%. latency P95 back to ~180ms.

jane-cs: customer update: email sent: "We're investigating increased errors; mitigation in progress; will follow up with RCA." some customers replied asking for ETA.

maya (oncall): handoff to night shift in 40m. @sam please own post-mitigation validation and followups. I'll draft timeline and immediate timeline slides for postmortem.

sam (sre): will do. next steps: collect traces for failing requests, compare client SDK versions, capture routing policy diff, and collect model-variant mapping changelog.

irene (eng-runtime): I have the diff: last commit changed mapping for model:open-alpha -> prefer list [xlarge-quant-v2, large-int8] due to compatibility flag. will revert and add test. commit id: `b3f7e9a`.

maya (oncall): adding temporary mitigation to client-facing API: inject `X-Client-Retry-Strategy: exponential` into responses so older SDKs pick proper backoff. (reacted :thumbsup: by jane-cs)

sam (sre): running synthetic replay against canary environment to verify no amplification. small script:
```
for i in {1..100}; do curl -H "X-Request-Id:$i" https://api.redwood.ai/generate &
done
```
observed sensible retry spacing when header present.

lee (infra): leaving rate-limits on for affected orgs for 30m: `org.rate_limit.set(org_id, 200rps)` to prevent bursty clients from repeating flood.

jane-cs: updated customers with 30m ETA for stable behavior. one customer requested a conference call; scheduled for 21:00 UTC.

maya (oncall): summary before handoff: root cause = routing-policy mapping + no-server-side-jitter on failover + aggressive client retries -> amplification. mitigations = disabled region-fallback toggle, circuit-breaker on bad variant, warmup gate, temporary rate-limits, instruct SDK to backoff.

sam (sre): followups (assigned): irene -> revert mapping + add unit/integration tests; lee -> add jitter to failover requeues and deploy; infra -> add auto-throttle when cross-region spill detected; devex -> publish SDK advisory.

maya (oncall): handing off to @sam for overnight watch. I'll update incident channel after postmortem doc is started.

sam (sre): taking over. will keep monitoring for 2h and loop in product for customer compensation discussion if SLA breaches confirmed.

incident-bot: Incident marked as mitigated by maya at 21:11 UTC. Please attach incident summary using `/incident close` when done.

jane-cs: closing customer-facing note: "Issue mitigated; we will follow up with RCA within 48 hours."

maya (oncall): postmortem kickoff: creating doc and assigning action items. thanks everyone. :heart:"
